description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named List7 that displays a list of contacts with phone numbers. When an item is selected, it shows the phone type and number in a TextView.

classes.name: List7
classes.description: An activity that displays a list of contacts with phone numbers, allowing selection to show details.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads the contacts cursor, and sets up the list adapter.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Handles list item selection, retrieving phone details and displaying them.

methods.name: onNothingSelected
methods.description: Handles the case when no list item is selected (empty implementation).
